description: Na₃Sc₂(WO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.76 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent O atoms. There are two shorter (2.45 Å) and two longer (2.69 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six WO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-63°. All W-O bond lengths are 1.89 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four O atoms to form WO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-60°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.95 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Sc and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one W atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one W atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one W atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ScW trigonal pyramids.
